title: Off-Duty Webb County Deputy Constable Arrested After Alleged Nightclub Altercation
excerpt: An off-duty Webb County Precinct 1 deputy constable was arrested after an alleged altercation at a Laredo nightclub early Nov. 2, including an alleged biting of an officer, according to KGNS.
content:
An off-duty Webb County Precinct 1 deputy constable was arrested after an alleged altercation at a Laredo nightclub early Sunday, November 2, according to KGNS.

Sgt. Miguel Ángel Zúñiga was arrested after an alleged altercation with security staff and responding officers at La Misión nightclub at about 4:47 a.m., including an alleged biting of an officer, KGNS reported.

The charges reported were public intoxication, assault of a peace officer and resisting arrest, according to KGNS. Two victims were reported with minor injuries.

Zúñiga has been charged, not convicted, and is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
